quizName:
Hardest Questions in Kentucky
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is allowed with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you must make an emergency stop on an interstate, what should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to get the attention of other cars.
Get out of your vehicle and wave down the first car that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on an interstate, turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay in your vehicle if you can. High-speed traffic makes standing or walking on the highway very dangerous.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must obey. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: Which of the following driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs affect many driving skills, including reaction time, coordination, alertness, and focus.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What should you do if you become tired while driving?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Tiredness slows your reactions and makes driving dangerous. Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do if you are getting tired while driving?

options.text: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Take breaks every hour on long trips. Share driving with another person so you can both get rest.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that they are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in work zones?

options.text: Follow the driver in front of you closely.
Pass the driver in front of you as soon as you can.
Avoid tailgating and keep a safe following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid tailgating and keep a safe following distance.
questions.explanation: Keep a safe distance from barriers, trucks, equipment, workers, and other vehicles. Do not tailgate.

questions.question: Your vehicle breaks down on a public road. What should you do?

options.text: Stop where you are and turn on your hazard lights.
Stop where you are and hold down your horn.
Pull off the right side of the road and turn on your hazard lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the right side of the road and turn on your hazard lights.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle breaks down on a public road, pull to the right side if you can. Turn on your hazard lights so other drivers can see you.

questions.question: You feel tired while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to reach your destination faster.
Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, find a safe place to park and rest. Signs of fatigue include struggling to keep your eyes open and drifting from your lane. A short nap is the best solution.

questions.question: You see lowered railroad crossing gates and flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates are up.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates are up.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when gates are lowered or warning lights flash. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks, both marked and unmarked. You must stop and let them cross.

questions.question: You encounter an aggressive driver. What should you do?
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not compete with them.

questions.question: A green traffic light is on, but a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's instructions, even if they conflict with traffic signals or signs.

questions.question: Drowsiness affects driving the same way alcohol and drugs do. How?

options.text: It makes you a better driver.

questions.explanation: Sleepiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment—just like alcohol and drugs.

questions.question: You feel drowsy while driving. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest area and take a nap, stretch, or switch drivers. Caffeine pills are not a safe substitute for rest.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: You want to turn right at a corner. A pedestrian with a guide dog is at the corner and is about to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses the street.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross the street.
Wait until the person crosses the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians with guide dogs or white canes always have the right-of-way. You must let them cross before you move.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where is the safest place for children age 12 and under to sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. All children age 12 and under must sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: If you have an argument with someone and feel angry, what should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud radio music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to release stress.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions affect your ability to drive safely. Wait until you feel calm before driving. You need to focus on the road without thinking about what upset you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down. It takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: A truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right. What should you do?

options.text: Turn right before the truck or bus.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
questions.explanation: Do not try to squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb. You could crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for cyclists and other road users in the area.
